class.name: IfcCurve
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A curve can be envisioned as the path of a point moving in its coordinate space. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: curve, only the following subtypes have been incorporated into IFC: line as IfcLine , conic as IfcConic , bounded_curve as IfcBoundedCurve .
